name: serif quote fades to a small mark
looks: On a plain cream field, a quiet serif line fades in, with a second line beneath it a beat later in the accent colour and a handwritten-feel italic. It cross-fades to a small coloured-book mark and a one-line caption.
build: Two DOM lines keyed in on a slow fade-and-rise (0.4-0.5 s, power2.out), the second a beat behind the first; cross-fade to the mark settling on a short spring.
sound: Near silence, a very soft pad swell.
prompt: Open on a plain field with a quiet statement that fades in line by line, its final line in the accent colour. Let that accent line shrink into a small brand mark settling with one short caption, to move from idea to product without a hard cut.
